statement: Prime Minister Narendra Modi has not held a press conference at which he took open questions from journalists since taking office in 2014. At his only press conference as Prime Minister — in May 2019, during the general election — he made a statement but deferred every question to the party president beside him. He has instead communicated through curated interviews, addresses and social media.
